title: The Verdict of Ashcombe
author: Ansel Villalobos
blurb: Casper Montrose, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
